01 / Product scope and delivery proposal

MathConcept Digital Teaching & Centre Management System

Proposed functions, operating rules, delivery scope and commercial items for review. This document covers the use of existing materials, teaching and student work, centre administration and franchise management.

Scope overview

AreaProposed scopeSections
Materials and curriculumControlled access to existing materials, approved printing, content organisation, question reuse and new worksheet creation.03–05
Teaching and student workClass and student selection, progress-chart assignment, digital working, teacher marking and corrections.06–07
Centre and parent operationsStudent records, scheduling, leave, make-up lessons, temporary or permanent timetable changes and parent communication.08
Billing and reconciliationInvoice queues, payment proof review, agreed receipt issuance, reminders and bank-statement reconciliation.09
HQ and franchise managementCentre permissions, approved curriculum, shared operating rules, oversight and access changes when staff or franchises leave.10
Delivery and commercial termsPilot scope, responsibilities, acceptance criteria, phased rollout, pricing items, support and ownership.11–12

Planning basis

The proposal covers the existing teaching-material library and approximately 20,000 students across centres. The materials included in the first release and the pilot group must be confirmed before fees and delivery dates are agreed.

Interactive examples use the current UI demo. Proposed functions and acceptance conditions are specified in the relevant sections; a demonstration does not establish readiness for live operation.
